format: Double Crisis (DCR, 2015): cards not already in the pool. No regulation mark: Expanded.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Burning Draft
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fighting or Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flame Ball
attacks.text: Move a basic Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hail Storm
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Team Magma Pokémon, it does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dual Blizzard
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. Does 80 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Team Aqua's Kyogre-EX
cards.text: Pokémon-EX rule: when a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: If there are 4 or fewer Team Aqua Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

abilities.name: Sludge Festival
abilities.text: Each Pokémon in play, except Team Aqua Pokémon, has its Retreat Cost increased by Colorless.

attacks.name: Pester
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, it does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venom Tail
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, discard an Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

abilities.name: Magma Switch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your Team Magma Pokémon.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Rock Stomp
attacks.text: Discard as many Fighting Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. Does 40 damage for each Fighting Energy you discarded.

attacks.name: Boulder Storm
attacks.text: Also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Team Magma's Groudon-EX
cards.text: Pokémon-EX rule: when a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: If there are 4 or fewer Team Magma Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Magma Quake
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has damage counters on it, it does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Infiltrate
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Teampact
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your Team Aqua Pokémon in play. Does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hostile Fang
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Team Aqua Pokémon, it does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Does 10 damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Aqua Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look through your deck for a Team Aqua Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Look through your deck for up to 2 Basic Team Magma Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Team Play
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of Team Magma Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.name: Aqua Diffuser
cards.text: The Team Aqua Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

attacks.name: Aqua Diffuser
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused and Poisoned.

cards.name: Magma Pointer
cards.text: The Team Magma Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

attacks.name: Magma Pointer
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Team Aqua Admin
cards.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Team Aqua Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Aqua Grunt
cards.text: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Aqua Pokémon, draw 4 cards instead.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Great Ball
cards.text: Look through your deck for a Basic Team Aqua Pokémon and a basic Water Energy card, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Secret Base
cards.text: Each Pokémon in play, except Team Aqua Pokémon, has its Retreat Cost increased by Colorless.

cards.name: Team Magma Admin
cards.text: Put up to 3 Team Magma Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Team Magma Grunt
cards.text: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Magma Pokémon, draw 4 cards instead.

cards.name: Team Magma's Great Ball
cards.text: Look through your deck for a Basic Team Magma Pokémon and a basic Fighting Energy card, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Team Magma's Secret Base
cards.text: Whenever any player plays a Basic Pokémon (except Team Magma Pokémon) from their hand onto their Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Double Aqua Energy
cards.text: This card can only be attached to Team Aqua Pokémon. This card provides WaterWater Energy only while it is attached to a Team Aqua Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn it was attached. (If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Aqua Pokémon, discard this card.)

cards.name: Double Magma Energy
cards.text: This card can only be attached to Team Magma Pokémon. This card provides FightingFighting Energy only while it is attached to a Team Magma Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn it was attached. (If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Magma Pokémon, discard this card.)
